somalia-2767/establishment.council: The Security Council adopted resolution 2767 (2024) by 14 votes in favour, none against and one abstention. It established AUSSOM as the successor to ATMIS.

sources.card: The United States abstained on resolution 2767 (2024), citing funding concerns. It reaffirmed its commitment to strengthening African Union peace support operations.
France welcomed the adoption of resolution 2767 (2024), establishing AUSSOM. It said Somalia could count on France's support in that effort.
